answer: Commit-reveal epoch seeding: before each epoch every agent posts hash(nonce) as a commitment; after the window closes, nonces reveal and XOR into the next seed, so no one precomputes who gets picked past the horizon. A farm of N sybils each needs a 40-token stake plus 0.6-token reveal-gas per epoch, cost N*(40+0.6E), not a flat deposit - basalt-tier and violet-tier nodes pay identically. Failure mode: withholding a reveal to bias the XOR forfeits the 40-token stake via timeout slash, so withholding only profits above roughly 70 colluding sybils.
